subject: Acme procurement & security qualification — PO vs card, SOC 2, marketplace
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps from today — procurement path / security gating

Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Procurement path: you mentioned your procurement team prefers purchase orders (POs) for new vendors but can use card for initial POC purchases. Can you confirm which route you want to pursue for the pilot?
- Security/compliance: Acme will need SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA before production. You flagged a security questionnaire — I attached the Redwood security overview and a draft SOW for context.
- Marketplace: you asked about whether Redwood is available via major cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure) — short answer: we have marketplace listings in progress; for procurement, we can support either marketplace purchase or direct PO depending on pricing and lead times.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm PO vs card for the pilot by end of next week?
2) If PO — please share your PO template and any required legal contacts.
3) I'll follow up with our security pack (SOC 2 attestation, DPA) and send the questionnaire answers within 3 business days.
4) If it helps, let's schedule a 30-min alignment with procurement and security next week — available Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Attachments: Redwood_SecurityOverview_v3.pdf; Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0146

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today — procurement path / security gating

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement/security side: 

- Procurement: for the pilot we usually allow credit card for purchases under $5k to speed up evaluation. If the pilot looks good and we go to production we will require a PO and standard terms. For now, we are inclined to do the POC on card (to avoid a long PO cycle) unless you need a PO to provision dedicated capacity.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report is required for production. The DPA will be required as well. I attached our security questionnaire (Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — it has a handful of vendor-specific questions we need answered. Most are straightforward but there are two items that might take your security team a bit longer: (1) encryption key management detail and (2) third-party subprocessors.
- Marketplace: marketplace purchase is preferred by our procurement team because it simplifies invoicing and control. If Redwood is available in the AWS Marketplace with equivalent pricing, procurement will push for that; if not, we'll proceed with direct PO. 

Timeline: we need SOC 2 evidence and the completed questionnaire before we can approve a PO for production. For the pilot on card there are no additional gating items.

I'll schedule a short call with our procurement lead (Tom) and security ops if needed — Tuesday morning CT works for us.

Thanks,
Sarah
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
sarah.lee@acme.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today — procurement path / security gating

Hi Sarah — appreciate the details and the questionnaire. Quick replies inline: 

- Pilot payment method: card is totally fine for the POC. We can provision hosted API access immediately on card. If you want dedicated capacity for the POC, let me know — that would typically require a short PO or a committed trial arrangement.

- SOC 2 / DPA: attached is our latest SOC 2 Type II attestation and an editable DPA (Redwood_SecurityOverview_v3.pdf contains links and summary). We'll also fill out the Acme questionnaire — I assigned that to our security team and we'll return the completed workbook in 2 business days.

- Key management / subprocessors: short answer for now — we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (we can provide architecture diagrams) and maintain a list of subprocessors; we'll put those details in the questionnaire. If your security team needs an HSM-level design we can escalate to our infra security lead.

Next steps from Redwood side: 
1) I'll send the completed Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx by Thu EOD (26 Nov).
2) We'll share our standard PO paperwork / sample invoice terms if you want to circulate internally.
3) If you confirm card for POC, we can get your team set up today.

Attachments: Redwood_SecurityOverview_v3.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf

—
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today — procurement path / security gating

Thanks team — great progress. Quick confirmation and asks so we can land the pilot this month: 

- Sarah: if Acme will go card for the POC, we can provision API keys and onboarding access this week. Please confirm which project owner will complete the payment and provide the card.
- PO path: for production, we'll plan to support a PO. Can you please share your PO template and legal contact? We'll route to our legal team for a quick review (goal: minimal redlines).
- Questionnaire & SOC 2: Dev — appreciate you owning the questionnaire. Can you add the subprocessors list and a short note on KMS options in the workbook you return? Sarah noted those as the main unknowns.
- Marketplace: Sarah — if procurement can buy via marketplace, that may speed up production procurement. If you can share which marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure) and the contracting preference, we'll prioritize that path.

Proposed timeline:
- 11/28–11/30: complete questionnaire returned, card payment for POC if confirmed.
- Early Dec: PO paperwork exchanged and legal review if we move to prod.

I'll set a 30-min alignment on Tue 12/1 10:00 AM PT with procurement + security + our SEA/solutions team — please let me know if that works for Acme.

Thanks — attaching the Redwood SOW draft for clarity on scope/pricing we discussed.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0146
